domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 主要由卷积结构组成并用于文中扣件损伤识别的神经网络。
usage_overview: 用于根据振动信号识别钢轨扣件损伤。在这类检测网络中，以卷积结构替代全连接结构，使网络能够处理不同长度的输入，适应振动信号长度变化的分析需求。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

P048.authors: M Chen, W Zhai, S Zhu, L Xu, Y Sun

complete_examples.text: A fastener damage detection network (FDDN) is built based on the fully convolutional network (FCN) [30–33] to learn the mapping between the ABA signals and the fastener damage by means of the supervised learning, and thereby predict the damage.
To address this lim-itation, this work presents a vibration-based detection method by introducingthefullyconvolutionalnetwork(FCN)toidentifyinvisible damages of fasteners.
